entries.value: Report a Bug

File a bug report. Fill in the details, then Open on GitHub launches the pre-filled bug form in your browser, or Send to Server uploads it to the connected Basis server like a crash report. Fields marked * are required.
Enable Bug Reporting
Reveal the bug report form. Build info and recent logs are attached automatically on submit.
Title
A short, descriptive summary of the bug. Becomes the GitHub issue title.
Describe the bug? *
Plainly detail what actually happened.
Steps to reproduce *
The steps needed to reproduce the behavior.
Expected behavior *
What you expected to happen instead.
Screenshots
Links to images or video. You can also attach media after the GitHub page opens.
Build info *
Auto-filled from your current build and hardware. Leave as-is unless you need to edit it.
Log files *
A snippet of the log around the problem. Use Attach Recent Logs to fill this from the current session.
Attach Recent Logs
Fill the Log files field with the tail of this session's log.
Additional context
Any other detail about the issue.
Open on GitHub
Open the pre-filled GitHub bug form in your browser to review and submit.
Copy Report to Clipboard
Copy the report as Markdown so you can paste it into GitHub manually.
Please fill in the required fields (marked *) before opening the report.
Opening the pre-filled bug report in your browser. Review the details and submit on GitHub.
The report was too long for the URL, so the full text was copied to your clipboard. Review the GitHub form and paste anything that is missing.

Send to Server
Upload this report to the connected Basis server, the same way a crash or exception is reported. Requires a server connection with reporting enabled.
